column1: POWERACT Consulting · journi Deliverables Structure — Full Specs (D11-D29)

Level = Step | Task | UseCase; Object_ID references D02 (Step_ID/Task_ID) or D15/D15c (AI_Use_Case_ID/Custom_AIUC_ID). HITL_Required = Yes wherever Final_Mode includes AI, consistent with journi's platform-wide rule that no AI Use Case Library output acts without a human checkpoint (CTRL-006) — the matrix never recommends a pure-AI Final_Mode for that reason. RPA_Score is uniformly low: journi has no unattended-bot execution surface (see D14 RPA_Tasks_Count = 0 note).
